thread:
maria-cs: FYI we have a NovaHomes escalation — embeddings endpoint returns 403, chat/generation works fine. customer says they didn't change anything. attaching repro below.

maria-cs: Repro steps from customer:
1) Hit /v1/embeddings with tenant service key
2) Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","detail":"missing: embeddings"} 
3) Same key succeeds against /v1/chat.

maria-cs: Example curl they sent:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer svc_ABC123" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -d '{"input":"hi"}'
# -> 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","detail":"missing: embeddings"}
```

devin-eng: Can you paste the raw token payload they provided (decoded JWT) and the exact header they use?

maria-cs: Pasted token claims (redacted):
```json
{
  "sub":"svc:tenant-548",
  "scp":"inference embeddings",
  "iss":"redwood-provisioner",
  "exp":1912345678
}
```

devin-eng: Hmm scp looks correct. Two quick hypotheses: 1) our authorizer expects scopes as comma-delimited and rejects space-delimited, or 2) there's a pre-auth proxy rewriting header.

sam-platform: I can check LB logs — any chance they rotate service keys or hit a different cluster? Give me the request-id from the 403.

maria-cs: Request-ID: rwh-9a7c0f2d. Customer timestamp: 2025-12-03T14:02:11Z.

infra-bot: deploy-bot detected a config change to auth-proxy at 2025-12-03T13:55:10Z (rollout: auth-proxy v3.4.2). Linking logs...

luis-ml: If proxy strips Authorization or rewrites token before authz, chat path might bypass proxy (route A) while embeddings hits route B — would explain selective 403.

devin-eng: Good catch. Sam, can you grep LB for rwh-9a7c0f2d and show the upstream route and headers? Also include X-Scope header if present.

sam-platform: Found it — upstream route: infer-embed-prod. Observed headers: Authorization present, but there is also an X-Scopes header set to "inference,embeddings". However auth-proxy forwarded scp claim as "inference,embeddings," (note trailing comma).

maria-cs: Customer's original scp was space-delimited; the X-Scopes now has a trailing comma.

devin-eng: A trailing comma would break our regex match for exact scope tokens (we match /(?:^|,)embeddings(?:,|$)/). If there's an extra trailing comma the pattern still should match — but looks like auth-proxy normalizes spaces -> commas and appends a comma unconditionally. That could produce an empty scope token which some old matcher treats as malformed and rejects the whole claim.

luis-ml: We recently merged a stricter parser in auth service that treats any empty token as failure (PR #894). If proxy starts emitting an empty token "" we return 403 with missing scope detail. That would be consistent.

devin-eng: Repro on staging: I simulated scp="inference embeddings" then proxy normalization -> "inference,embeddings," and auth service returned 403 with detail "missing: embeddings". Confirmed.

maria-cs: Customer impacted in prod. Severity: high (several requests failing).

eli-oncall: Rollback plan: revert auth-proxy normalization step or patch auth service to ignore empty tokens. Which is faster?

sam-platform: Easiest immediate mitigation: add a temporary rule in auth-proxy to trim trailing commas and dedupe, rollout within 10 min. Rolling back proxy change would be heavier.

devin-eng: I'll open a hotfix on auth-proxy to sanitize scope header before forward. Patch: replace /,+$/ -> '' and split on /[,\s]+/. Quick patch and canary.

eli-oncall: Can we hotpatch and monitor error rate for rwh-9a7c0f2d and similar IDs?

sam-platform: Pushing canary now (auth-proxy v3.4.2-hotfix1) to 10% of traffic for infer-embed-prod.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: started rollout v3.4.2-hotfix1 -> 10% (canary).

maria-cs: Customer notified of triage and expected ~30m to full mitigation. They asked why chat unaffected — explained routing difference.

devin-eng: Postmortem notes: provisioning and proxy agreed on different canonicalization (space vs comma). Auth-service recent strictness amplified bug. Action items:
- short: sanitize scope header in proxy (done)
- med: relax empty-token rejection in auth-service with warning log + metric
- long: standardize scope serialization in provisioner and add contract tests

luis-ml: I'll add an eval to run nightly that hits all endpoints with mixed-delimiter scopes to prevent regressions.

maria-cs: Thanks team — will close escalation after full rollout and customer confirmation. :thumbsup:
